S0647.reason: Hart’s myth/prediction slogan flattens the realists’ actual claim that doctrine is inadequate without empirical study of law in action, the step that opened a sociological approach; A and B misdescribe realism.

S0070.reason: Prior seizures can indicate an unstable or progressive neurologic disorder, the recognized reason to defer DTaP; egg allergy and gestational age are not DTaP contraindications.

S0108.reason: Kadi’s new limit on giving UNSC resolutions effect in the EU is fundamental-rights review of the implementing act; it did not deny their international binding force or invent a transformation requirement.
